answer: The cedar is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the vault. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, revoked by a single upheld challenge, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Reaching the garden of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
